   (k) "Preventive Maintenance" means the scheduled inspection, testing, cleaning, calibration, and replacement of components as set out in the Preventive Maintenance Plan (Schedule C).
   (l) "Response Time" means the time elapsed between the Contractor's receipt of a valid Service Request and the arrival of Contractor Personnel at the relevant Site.
   (m) "Service Request" means a written or electronic request from the Client for corrective or diagnostic services.
   (n) "Services" means the maintenance services described in Clause 2.

   (b) **Corrective Maintenance:** Diagnosis and repair of Equipment failures, including replacement of defective components, in accordance with the Response Times set out in Schedule B.
